questions.explanation: 上下文依据：前面提到这是旅行中来自陌生人的善意，无法回报，接下来作者说“很快我们在空间上就会变得遥远，并永远失去联系”。distant 意为“遥远的”，符合物理距离变远的语境。易错点：可能误选C(helpless)，但这里强调的是空间距离的拉大而非心理上的无助。
questions.supplement:
A(restless)：语境句：The audience grew restless as they waited for the delayed concert to begin. 固定搭配：grow restless, a restless night
B(active)：语境句：Staying physically active is essential for a healthy lifestyle. 固定搭配：stay active, an active role
C(helpless)：语境句：When her car broke down in the middle of nowhere, she felt completely helpless. 固定搭配：feel helpless, leave sb helpless
D(distant)：语境句：The sound of distant thunder warned us of the approaching storm. 固定搭配：a distant memory, distant relatives

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：这是一种“没有过去，很可能也没有未来”的相遇（陌生人之间的偶遇）。encounter 意为“相遇，邂逅”，最符合语境。易错点：可能误选B(assumption)，但此处描述的是真实的经历而非假设。
questions.supplement:
A(encounter)：语境句：Their unexpected encounter in the coffee shop led to a lifelong friendship. 固定搭配：a chance encounter, a brief encounter
B(assumption)：语境句：You should never make an assumption about someone's background without knowing them. 固定搭配：make an assumption, on the assumption that
C(achievement)：语境句：Winning the championship was the greatest achievement of his sports career. 固定搭配：a sense of achievement, outstanding achievement
D(inspiration)：语境句：The beautiful scenery of the countryside served as an inspiration for her paintings. 固定搭配：draw inspiration from, a source of inspiration

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：第一段说旅途中的偶遇往往无果而终，紧接着用“Yet”转折，说明“也有例外（exceptions）”，并引出后文作者遇到善良女士并被赠予鲜花的长久记忆。
questions.supplement:
A(alternatives)：语境句：If this plan fails, we need to have some viable alternatives ready. 固定搭配：provide alternatives, leave no alternative but to do
B(doubts)：语境句：I have some serious doubts about his ability to manage the project successfully. 固定搭配：cast doubt on, without a doubt
C(exceptions)：语境句：There are always exceptions to grammatical rules in the English language. 固定搭配：with the exception of, make an exception
D(rules)：语境句：You must follow the safety rules while working in the chemistry laboratory. 固定搭配：break the rules, against the rules

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：前面提到“Several ladies were taking pictures there”，其中一位拿着花在“摆姿势（posing）”。pose 意为“摆姿势”，常用于拍照场景。
questions.supplement:
A(running)：语境句：She came running down the stairs when she heard the good news. 固定搭配：go running, a running track
B(posing)：语境句：The models were posing for photographs in front of the historic building. 固定搭配：pose for a photo, strike a pose
C(painting)：语境句：He has been painting landscapes since he was a teenager. 固定搭配：oil painting, finish painting
D(performing)：语境句：The students will be performing a classic play at the end of the term. 固定搭配：perform a task, perform well

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：作者走上前夸赞花很漂亮，这位女士立刻“主动提出（offered）”把花给作者拍照。offer to do sth 意为“主动提出做某事”。易错点：agreed 表示同意别人的请求，但这里作者只是夸赞，并未提出要借花，是女士主动给的。
questions.supplement:
A(resolved)：语境句：The committee quickly resolved the conflict between the two departments. 固定搭配：resolve to do sth, resolve a problem
B(hesitated)：语境句：He hesitated for a moment before giving his final answer to the judge. 固定搭配：hesitate to do sth, without hesitating
C(offered)：语境句：She kindly offered to help me carry the heavy luggage to my room. 固定搭配：offer to do sth, offer sb sth
D(agreed)：语境句：After a long discussion, they finally agreed on the terms of the contract. 固定搭配：agree with sb, agree to do sth

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：拿到美丽的花拍照，作者感到很高兴，因此是“快乐地（joyfully）”笑了。
questions.supplement:
A(joyfully)：语境句：The children shouted joyfully when they saw the snow falling outside. 固定搭配：sing joyfully, smile joyfully
B(awkwardly)：语境句：He stood awkwardly in the corner, not knowing anyone at the party. 固定搭配：laugh awkwardly, stand awkwardly
C(nervously)：语境句：She waited nervously in the hallway before her job interview. 固定搭配：look nervously, wait nervously
D(secretly)：语境句：He was secretly hoping that she would invite him to her birthday party. 固定搭配：secretly admire, smile secretly

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：这名陌生人的善意并未就此结束，她坚持让作者把花“留下（keep）”，直接送给了作者。
questions.supplement:
A(purchase)：语境句：They plan to purchase a new house in the suburbs next year. 固定搭配：purchase goods, a major purchase
B(keep)：语境句：You can keep the book as a gift if you really like it. 固定搭配：keep a promise, keep in touch
C(throw)：语境句：Please don't throw your rubbish on the ground in the park. 固定搭配：throw away, throw light on
D(deliver)：语境句：The postman will deliver the package to your office tomorrow morning. 固定搭配：deliver a speech, deliver a message

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：这位女士之所以坚持送花，是因为她看出这束花“促成了/带来了（contributed to）”作者的快乐。contribute to 意为“有助于，促成”。
questions.supplement:
A(took away)：语境句：The police took away the suspect for further questioning. 固定搭配：take away, take one's breath away
B(put out)：语境句：The firefighters worked hard to put out the forest fire quickly. 固定搭配：put out a fire, put out an announcement
C(contributed to)：语境句：Regular exercise and a healthy diet contributed to his quick recovery. 固定搭配：contribute to, make a contribution to
D(stood for)：语境句：The dove has always stood for peace and harmony in many cultures. 固定搭配：stand for, stand out

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：人们通常从爱人那里收到花，而从陌生人那里收到花是一件非常“珍贵的（precious）”事。
questions.supplement:
A(stressful)：语境句：Moving to a new city and starting a new job can be a stressful experience. 固定搭配：a stressful situation, highly stressful
B(natural)：语境句：It is natural for parents to worry about their children's safety. 固定搭配：natural disaster, natural resources
C(odd)：语境句：It's a bit odd that he didn't call you on your birthday. 固定搭配：an odd number, against all odds
D(precious)：语境句：We should treasure every precious moment we spend with our families. 固定搭配：precious time, precious memories

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：虽然花最终会枯萎，但这件美好相遇的“记忆（memory）”会永远留在作者心中。呼应了上一段的“I still remember...”。
questions.supplement:
A(lesson)：语境句：His failure in the exam taught him a valuable lesson about the importance of hard work. 固定搭配：teach sb a lesson, learn a lesson
B(memory)：语境句：The sweet memory of her childhood still remains fresh in her mind. 固定搭配：in memory of, sweet memory
C(wisdom)：语境句：The old man shared his wisdom and life experiences with the young generation. 固定搭配：conventional wisdom, words of wisdom
D(friendship)：语境句：Their strong friendship has lasted for over twenty years despite the distance. 固定搭配：build a friendship, long-lasting friendship

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：这个小礼物成为了一个有力的“提醒物（reminder）”，提醒我们人们可以对他人表现出善意。reminder 指让人回忆起某事的事物。
questions.supplement:
A(shadow)：语境句：The tall building cast a long shadow across the quiet street in the late afternoon. 固定搭配：cast a shadow, in the shadow of
B(feature)：语境句：The unique architectural design is the most striking feature of this modern museum. 固定搭配：distinguishing feature, key feature
C(reminder)：语境句：The scar on his arm served as a constant reminder of the terrible accident. 固定搭配：serve as a reminder, a gentle reminder
D(purpose)：语境句：The main purpose of this meeting is to discuss the new marketing strategy. 固定搭配：on purpose, serve a purpose

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：此处指代人们可以向他人“展示/表达（show）”善意。show goodness to others 是符合逻辑的搭配。
questions.supplement:
A(award)：语境句：The school will award scholarships to students with outstanding academic records. 固定搭配：win an award, award a prize
B(introduce)：语境句：The manager will introduce the new employee to the rest of the team. 固定搭配：introduce sb to sb, introduce a new system
C(lend)：语境句：Could you lend me some money until I get paid next week? 固定搭配：lend sb a hand, lend money to sb
D(show)：语境句：We should always show respect to the elderly members of our community. 固定搭配：show respect for, show off

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：在那次旅行中，作者“擦肩而过（passed）”了很多人，但偏偏对这段经历记忆犹新。pass 表示经过、路过。
questions.supplement:
A(passed)：语境句：A few months passed before she finally received a reply to her letter. 固定搭配：pass by, pass away
B(supported)：语境句：My parents have always supported my decision to study art abroad. 固定搭配：support a family, strongly support
C(missed)：语境句：He missed the early train and was late for the important meeting. 固定搭配：miss the opportunity, miss the point
D(changed)：语境句：The invention of the internet has completely changed the way we communicate. 固定搭配：change one's mind, change for the better

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：送一束花是一个极其“简单的（simple）”举动，但它却能产生深远的影响（go a long way）。
questions.supplement:
A(brave)：语境句：It was very brave of him to rescue the child from the freezing river. 固定搭配：a brave attempt, brave the elements
B(simple)：语境句：Sometimes a simple apology is all it takes to mend a broken relationship. 固定搭配：pure and simple, simple truth
C(timely)：语境句：The timely arrival of the medical team saved the lives of many injured people. 固定搭配：in a timely manner, timely help
D(firm)：语境句：The manager took a firm stand on the issue of environmental protection. 固定搭配：firm belief, stand firm

questions.explanation: 上下文依据：这些花让作者开心了一整天，每次回想起来，世界都似乎变得稍微“更明亮/更美好（brighter）”了一些。brighter 象征心情的愉悦与世界的温暖。
questions.supplement:
A(smaller)：语境句：With the development of transportation, the world seems to have become smaller. 固定搭配：a smaller amount, on a smaller scale
B(richer)：语境句：Reading good books can make our spiritual life much richer and more meaningful. 固定搭配：grow richer, richer in flavor
C(safer)：语境句：Installing security cameras can make the neighborhood a safer place to live. 固定搭配：safer environment, play it safe
D(brighter)：语境句：With a positive attitude, you will definitely have a brighter future. 固定搭配：a brighter future, look on the bright side

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be friendly, generous, or gentle towards someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 'is kind to' 为一般现在时，系动词 is 后接形容词 kind，搭配介词 to，表示对某人友善。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is important to be kind to strangers when traveling.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 旅行时对陌生人友善很重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: when a stranger is kind to us

vocab_pack.definition_en: during the act of travelling
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 连词 while 后接现在分词 travelling，构成时间状语，表示‘在旅行过程中’。
vocab_pack.example_en: While travelling, he met many interesting people.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 旅行时，他遇到了很多有趣的人。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to do something for someone in return for a kind act they did for you
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 'cannot be returned' 为被动语态，情态动词 cannot 后接 be returned，表示‘无法被回报’。
vocab_pack.example_en: She helped me, and I hope to return the favour someday.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她帮了我，我希望有一天能回报这个人情。

vocab_pack.definition_en: far away in space; not close in physical location
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 物理上遥远的，身距遥远的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'physically distant' 为形容词短语，用作表语，与 be 动词连用，表示‘在空间上相隔很远’。
vocab_pack.example_en: Even though we are physically distant, our friendship remains strong.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 虽然我们天各一方，但友谊依然牢固。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to no longer have contact or a relationship with each other
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'lost to each other' 为过去分词作形容词，与 be 动词构成系表结构，表示‘彼此失去联系’的状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: After graduation, they were lost to each other for decades.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 毕业后，他们彼此失去了联系数十年。

vocab_pack.definition_en: an unexpected or casual meeting with someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'an encounter' 为可数名词单数，前有不定冠词 an，作主语补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The encounter with an old friend made my day.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 与老友的偶遇让我一整天都很开心。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It's an encounter with no past

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to say that the rule or situation is not always true; some cases differ
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'there are exceptions' 为 there be 句型，一般现在时，主语 exceptions 复数，表示‘有一些例外情况’。
vocab_pack.example_en: Usually I avoid spicy food, but there are exceptions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 通常我不吃辣，但也有例外。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a place with beautiful natural or man‑made scenery, often a tourist attraction
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'a scenic spot' 为名词短语，介词 to 的宾语，a 表示泛指一个景点。
vocab_pack.example_en: We visited several scenic spots along the coast.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们游览了沿海的几个景点。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a family trip to a scenic spot in Georgia

vocab_pack.definition_en: a number of things (usually flowers, keys, grapes) tied or grouped together; also used informally for 'a lot of'
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 一束；一把；一群（可指数个物品）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'a bunch of flowers' 为数量短语，修饰可数名词 flowers，表示‘一束花’。
vocab_pack.example_en: She bought a bunch of flowers for her mother.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她给妈妈买了一束花。
vocab_pack.from_passage: posing with a bunch of flowers

vocab_pack.definition_en: to approach someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'went up to' 为过去式，go 的不规则变化，后接介词 to，表示‘走到某人面前’。
vocab_pack.example_en: He went up to the teacher and asked a question.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他走到老师面前问了一个问题。

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to express admiration or delight about something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为感叹句结构 'how + 形容词 (+ 主语 + 谓语)'，'how lovely they were' 表示对花的赞美。
vocab_pack.example_en: How lovely the sunset looks tonight!
vocab_pack.example_zh: 今晚的日落看起来多么美丽！

vocab_pack.definition_en: to express willingness to do something for someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'offered to give' 为过去时，offer 后接不定式 to give，表示‘主动提出给’。
vocab_pack.example_en: She offered to help me with my homework.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她主动提出帮我做作业。
vocab_pack.from_passage: she offered to give me the flowers

vocab_pack.definition_en: to photograph someone or something using a camera
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'to take a picture with' 为不定式短语，表示目的；take 为原形，a picture 为宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Could you take a picture of us in front of the fountain?
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你能在喷泉前给我们拍张照吗？

vocab_pack.definition_en: to smile in a happy, delighted manner
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'smiled joyfully' 为过去时，动词 smile 后接副词 joyfully 作状语，表示‘高兴地笑了’。
vocab_pack.example_en: She smiled joyfully when she received the gift.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 收到礼物时，她开心地笑了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I smiled joyfully as my mom took out her camera

vocab_pack.definition_en: to remove something from a container, pocket, bag, etc.
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'took out' 为过去式，take 的不规则变化，out 为副词，宾语放在短语后（her camera）。
vocab_pack.example_en: He took out his wallet to pay the bill.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他掏出钱包付账。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as my mom took out her camera

vocab_pack.definition_en: to stop or finish at that point (often used in negative to show continuation)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'didn't end there' 为否定形式，一般过去时，end 为原形，there 为副词，表示‘并没有就此结束’。
vocab_pack.example_en: His kindness did not end there; he continued to help us.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的好意并未就此结束；他继续帮助我们。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to demand or state firmly that something happen, using the subjunctive mood (verb base form)
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 坚持要求（后接虚拟语气从句）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'insisted that I keep' 中 insisted 为过去时，宾语从句使用虚拟语气（动词原形 keep），表示‘坚持要求我留着’。
vocab_pack.example_en: The doctor insisted that he stay in bed for a week.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 医生坚持要求他卧床一周。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The woman insisted that I keep the flowers

vocab_pack.definition_en: to help to cause or bring about something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'contributed to' 为过去时，contribute 后接介词 to，表示‘促成了我的幸福’。
vocab_pack.example_en: Regular exercise contributes to good health.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 定期锻炼有助于身体健康。

vocab_pack.definition_en: people whom one loves, especially family members and close friends
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'loved ones' 为固定名词短语，作介词 from 的宾语，loved 为过去分词作定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: During the holidays, we spend time with our loved ones.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 假期里，我们与亲人共度时光。

vocab_pack.definition_en: of great value; very important or dear
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'precious' 为形容词，在 it is so precious to receive 中作表语，so 表示程度。
vocab_pack.example_en: Time is precious; we should not waste it.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 时间是宝贵的，我们不应浪费。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it's so precious to receive them from a stranger

vocab_pack.definition_en: (of a plant) to become dry and die; (figuratively) to gradually disappear or decline
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'withered away' 为过去时，wither 为动词，away 为副词，表示‘逐渐枯萎凋谢’。
vocab_pack.example_en: The flowers withered away after a few days without water.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 几天没浇水，花就枯萎了。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to remain in one's memory or mind over time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'will stay with me' 为一般将来时，stay 为原形，with me 意为‘留在我心里’，指记忆不消失。
vocab_pack.example_en: The beautiful scenery will stay with me forever.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那美丽的景色将永远留在我的记忆中。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the memory will stay with me forever

vocab_pack.definition_en: something that strongly brings a fact, feeling, or memory to mind
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'a powerful reminder' 为名词短语，became 的宾语，powerful 为形容词修饰 reminder。
vocab_pack.example_en: This old photo is a powerful reminder of my childhood.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这张老照片有力地唤起我对童年的回忆。
vocab_pack.from_passage: became a powerful reminder of the goodness

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a great effect or be very helpful; to achieve a lot
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'can go a long way' 中情态动词 can 后接原形 go，a long way 为固定搭配，表示‘一个简单的举动可以大有帮助’。
vocab_pack.example_en: A smile can go a long way in making someone feel better.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一个微笑能让别人感觉好很多。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a simple action can go a long way

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make someone feel very happy on a particular day
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'made my day' 为过去时，make 的不规则变化，my 为形容词性物主代词，表示‘那些花让我那一天非常开心’。
vocab_pack.example_en: Your warm words really made my day!
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你温暖的话语真让我开心了一整天！

vocab_pack.definition_en: to recall or remember a past event
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'think back to it' 为一般现在时主语 I 时的原形，think back to 后接宾语 it，指代那段经历。
vocab_pack.example_en: When I think back to my childhood, I feel grateful.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 当我回想童年时，我心怀感激。
vocab_pack.from_passage: every time I think back to it

vocab_pack.definition_en: to appear more cheerful or full of light
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'seems a bit brighter' 中 seem 为系动词，一般现在时，brighter 为比较级，a bit 修饰，表示‘世界似乎明亮了一些’。
vocab_pack.example_en: After the good news, everything seemed brighter.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 好消息传来后，一切似乎都更美好了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the world seems a bit brighter

vocab_pack.definition_en: slowly, over a period of time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'gradually' 为副词，修饰动词 withered away，表示‘逐渐枯萎’。
vocab_pack.example_en: The sky gradually turned dark as night fell.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 夜幕降临，天空逐渐变暗。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the quality of being friendly, generous, and considerate
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'stranger's kindness' 为名词短语，kindness 为不可数名词，所有格表示‘陌生人的善意’。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her kindness touched everyone around her.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的善意感动了周围的每一个人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: this stranger's kindness didn't end there

vocab_pack.definition_en: a kind act that you do for someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'the favour' 为可数名词单数，前有定冠词 the，指上文提到的善意举动。
vocab_pack.example_en: Could you do me a favour and open the window?
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你能帮我个忙开一下窗户吗？

vocab_pack.definition_en: someone or something that is not included in a general statement or rule
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 'exceptions' 为可数名词复数，与 there are 连用，表示‘存在一些例外情况’。
vocab_pack.example_en: There is an exception to every rule.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每一条规则都有例外。

section_2_word_form.passage:
Huangshan-based lacquerware artisan Gan Erke has devoted his life to reviving (复兴) ancient lacquer techniques. His journey began at a local arts and crafts factory, [56] he noticed a gap between traditional Chinese lacquerware and modern global standards. This led him to revive the nearly lost rhinoceros leather (xi pi) lacquer technique, [57] (inspire) by a brief description in a Ming Dynasty text. After [58] (year) of experimentation, he successfully recreated and enhanced the technique by adding gold and increasing layers (层) from six to up to 102, [59] (achieve) greater depth and movement.
One of his [60] (influence) works is a round box with complex rhinoceros leather patterns. The surface is polished to [61] mirror-like finish, reflecting light beautifully. Another example is a tea container, to which Gan applied the same high standards, ensuring perfect polish both inside and out. Each piece takes over a year [62] (complete), as Gan aims for perfection.
Gan's works have earned [63] (recognize) at home and abroad. In 2011, one of his rhinoceros leather lacquered round boxes [64] (add) to the permanent collection at Beijing's Palace Museum. Major museums [65] the British Museum and the Metropolitan Museum of Art in the US have also acquired his pieces.

questions.explanation: 考查定语从句。先行词是 a local arts and crafts factory，在后面的非限制性定语从句中作地点状语，故填关系副词 where。
questions.supplement: 正确形(where)：语境句：This is the exact place where we first met ten years ago. 固定搭配：where appropriate, know where one stands. 所给词 None，无其它变形。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。逻辑主语与 inspire 之间是被动关系（受到...启发），故使用过去分词 inspired 作状语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(inspired)：语境句：Inspired by his teacher's words, he decided to apply for the top university. 固定搭配：be inspired by, feel inspired. 原词inspire其它变形：inspiration(n.), inspiring(adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查名词复数。表示“多年的实验”，year 前没有限定词，且结合句意应用复数形式 years，years of 为固定搭配。
questions.supplement: 正确形(years)：语境句：It took him several years of hard work to master the piano. 固定搭配：years of, over the years. 原词year其它变形：yearly(adj./adv.)

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。增加涂层层数，从而“实现了”更深层次的美感，这里表示自然而然的结果，用现在分词 achieving 作结果状语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(achieving)：语境句：She has been fully devoted to achieving her long-term career goals. 固定搭配：achieve a goal, achieve success. 原词achieve其它变形：achievement(n.), achievable(adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。修饰名词 works，需将动词/名词 influence 转换为形容词 influential（有影响力的）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(influential)：语境句：He is one of the most influential figures in modern history. 固定搭配：highly influential, an influential role. 原词influence其它变形：influence(n./v.)

questions.explanation: 考查冠词。finish 此处作单数可数名词，意为“表面光洁度/涂层”，泛指“一种如镜面般的光洁度”，故填不定冠词 a。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：The antique table has been restored to a perfect finish. 固定搭配：a lot of, as a result. 所给词 None，无其它变形。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词及句型。固定句型 take + 时间 + to do sth. 意为“花费时间做某事”，故填动词不定式 to complete。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to complete)：语境句：It will take the construction workers another two months to complete the bridge. 固定搭配：take time to complete, complete with. 原词complete其它变形：completion(n.), completely(adv.)

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。在谓语动词 earned 之后作宾语，需要将动词 recognize 转换为名词形式 recognition（认可，赞誉）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(recognition)：语境句：His tireless efforts in charity have earned him widespread recognition. 固定搭配：earn recognition, beyond recognition. 原词recognize其它变形：recognizable(adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查时态语态及主谓一致。主语是 one of his...boxes，为单数；时间状语 In 2011 决定了用一般过去时；且作品是被加入收藏的，故用被动语态 was added。
questions.supplement: 正确形(was added)：语境句：A new section was added to the final report to provide more details. 固定搭配：add to, add up. 原词add其它变形：addition(n.), additional(adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查介词。列举大英博物馆和美国大都会艺术博物馆作为主要博物馆的例子，表示“像...一样”或“包括...”，填 like（或 including 亦可）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(like)：语境句：She enjoys reading novels by classical authors like Charles Dickens and Jane Austen. 固定搭配：just like, something like. 所给词 None，无其它变形。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give all of one's time and energy to a particular activity or purpose
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时，has devoted 是 devote 的过去分词，表示从过去到现在一直奉献；后接介词 to 和动名词 reviving。主语为第三人称单数 Gan Erke。
vocab_pack.example_en: She devoted her life to helping the poor.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她一生致力于帮助穷人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: has devoted his life to reviving

vocab_pack.definition_en: to bring back into use, existence, or activity; to restore
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动名词形式，作介词 to 的宾语，表示复兴古代漆艺技术这一行为。
vocab_pack.example_en: Efforts are being made to revive the traditional craft.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 正在努力复兴这项传统工艺。
vocab_pack.from_passage: has devoted his life to reviving ancient lacquer techniques

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become aware of a difference or disparity between two things
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，notice 的过去式，后接名词短语 a gap between...and...，表示发现传统中式漆器与现代全球标准之间存在差距。
vocab_pack.example_en: The researcher noticed a gap between theory and practice.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 研究者注意到了理论与实践之间的差距。
vocab_pack.from_passage: noticed a gap between traditional Chinese lacquerware and modern global standards

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to take a particular action
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，lead 的过去式 led，后接宾语 him 和带 to 的不定式，表示这种差距导致他复兴某种技法。
vocab_pack.example_en: His curiosity led him to explore the unknown.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的好奇心促使他去探索未知。
vocab_pack.from_passage: led him to revive the nearly lost rhinoceros leather lacquer technique

vocab_pack.definition_en: almost no longer existing or available
vocab_pack.grammar_note: nearly 副词修饰过去分词 lost，整体作形容词定语，修饰后文的 lacquer technique，意思是几乎消失的技法。
vocab_pack.example_en: They are working to preserve the nearly lost language.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们正在努力保存这门几乎失传的语言。
vocab_pack.from_passage: revive the nearly lost rhinoceros leather lacquer technique

vocab_pack.definition_en: to fill someone with the urge or ability to do or feel something; to be the motivating force
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 启发；激励；作为灵感来源
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词，此处表被动，意为被一段简短的描述所启发。语法上为 v-ed 分词短语作状语，修饰主语 he。
vocab_pack.example_en: The artist was inspired by nature to create this painting.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位艺术家受到大自然的启发创作了这幅画。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a period of many years; used to indicate duration
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，years 为复数，后接 of 引出名词，表示长达多年的实验。在句中作介词 After 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: After years of training, he finally became a master.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 经过多年的训练，他终于成为大师。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make something again or anew; to reproduce
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，recreate 的过去式，与 enhanced 并列作谓语，表示他成功重新创造并改进了这种技法。
vocab_pack.example_en: The team tried to recreate the ancient recipe.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 团队试图重新创造古代配方。
vocab_pack.from_passage: successfully recreated and enhanced the technique

vocab_pack.definition_en: to improve the quality, value, or effectiveness of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，enhance 的过去式，与 recreated 并列，表示在重新创造的同时改进了技法。
vocab_pack.example_en: Adding spices can enhance the flavor of the dish.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 添加香料可以增强菜肴的风味。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to put gold into something as an ingredient or decoration
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语，adding 是 add 的动名词形式，与 increasing 并列作介词 by 的宾语，表示通过添加金和增加层数来实现改进。
vocab_pack.example_en: The craftsman added gold to the lacquer to create a luxurious effect.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 工匠在漆中加入金以营造奢华效果。
vocab_pack.from_passage: by adding gold and increasing layers

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make the number of layers greater
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语，increasing 是 increase 的动名词形式，与 adding 并列，表示通过增加层数来改进技法。
vocab_pack.example_en: To strengthen the material, they increased the layers of coating.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 为了加强材料，他们增加了涂层数。
vocab_pack.from_passage: adding gold and increasing layers from six to up to 102

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to indicate a maximum or upper limit
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语，与 from six to 构成结构，表示层数从六层增加到最多102层。
vocab_pack.example_en: The car can hold up to seven people.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这辆车最多可容纳七人。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to successfully reach a desired goal or result
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词作结果状语，表示通过添加金和增加层数，实现了更大的深度和动态感。
vocab_pack.example_en: By working hard, he achieved his dream.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 通过努力工作，他实现了自己的梦想。

vocab_pack.definition_en: having great influence or impact
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，修饰名词 works，表示他的作品之一是非常有影响力的。原文括号提示 influence 需变为形容词。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is one of the most influential scientists of the century.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她本世纪最具影响力的科学家之一。

vocab_pack.definition_en: consisting of many different and connected parts; complicated
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，修饰名词短语 rhinoceros leather patterns，表示复杂的犀皮纹理。
vocab_pack.example_en: The machine has a complex design.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这台机器有复杂的设计。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a surface that is as smooth and reflective as a mirror
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作介词 to 的宾语，与 polished 搭配，表示被抛光的表面达到镜面般效果。
vocab_pack.example_en: The table was polished to a mirror-like finish.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 桌子被抛光成镜面般光洁。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to send back light (from a surface)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语，作伴随状语，表示表面抛光后能够美丽地反射光线。
vocab_pack.example_en: A mirror reflects light perfectly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 镜子能完美反射光线。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to use a set of criteria or requirements for something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，apply 的过去式，后接宾语 the same high standards 和介词 to（原文为定语从句中 to which，即 applied to it），表示将高标准应用于茶容器。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company applies strict quality standards to all its products.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 公司对所有产品都实行严格的质量标准。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to which Gan applied the same high standards

vocab_pack.definition_en: very demanding or excellent levels of quality or achievement
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作 applied 的直接宾语，表示同样的高标准。
vocab_pack.example_en: The school maintains high standards of education.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这所学校保持高标准的教育。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make certain that something will happen or be the case
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词作结果状语，表示通过应用高标准，确保了内外完美的抛光。
vocab_pack.example_en: We must ensure the safety of all passengers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们必须确保所有乘客的安全。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ensuring perfect polish both inside and out

vocab_pack.definition_en: in all parts, including the interior and exterior
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定短语，作副词性修饰，修饰 polish，表示抛光既在内部也在外部。
vocab_pack.example_en: The house was cleaned both inside and out.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 房子里里外外都打扫干净了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ensuring perfect polish both inside and out

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: takes over a year to complete
vocab_pack.definition_en: to require a certain amount of time to finish something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，take 的第三人称单数形式 takes，后接时间短语 over a year 和不定式 to complete，表示每件作品需要一年多时间完成。
vocab_pack.example_en: This project will take about three months to complete.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个项目将花费大约三个月完成。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Each piece takes over a year to complete

vocab_pack.definition_en: to strive for or pursue an ideal state of flawlessness
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，aims 为第三人称单数（主语 Gan），后接介词 for 和名词 perfection，表示他追求完美。
vocab_pack.example_en: The chef always aims for perfection in every dish.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位厨师总是力求每道菜都完美。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to receive credit or acknowledgment for one's achievements
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时，have earned 是 earn 的现在完成形式，后接名词 recognition，表示他的作品在国内外赢得了认可。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her hard work earned her recognition from the industry.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的努力为她赢得了业界的认可。
vocab_pack.from_passage: have earned recognition at home and abroad

vocab_pack.definition_en: in one's own country and in foreign countries
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定短语，作状语修饰 earned recognition，表示认可来自国内外。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company has customers at home and abroad.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家公司在国内外都有客户。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to include something as part of a collection or group
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态，一般过去时，add 的过去分词 added，与 was 构成被动，表示被添加到故宫博物院永久收藏中。
vocab_pack.example_en: His painting was added to the museum's collection.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的画作被添加到博物馆的收藏中。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was added to the permanent collection

vocab_pack.definition_en: to gain possession of something (especially through effort or purchase)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，acquire 的过去式，表示大英博物馆等也获得了他的作品。
vocab_pack.example_en: The library acquired several rare books last year.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 图书馆去年获得了若干珍稀书籍。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a set of items that a museum or institution owns and displays on an ongoing basis
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作介词 to 的宾语，表示被添加到故宫博物院的永久收藏中。
vocab_pack.example_en: The sculpture is now part of the gallery's permanent collection.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座雕塑现已成为画廊永久收藏的一部分。
vocab_pack.from_passage: added to the permanent collection at Beijing's Palace Museum

vocab_pack.definition_en: the process of trying out new ideas, methods, or activities to see what happens
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词，作介词 of 的宾语，表示多年的实验。强调的是反复试验的过程。
vocab_pack.example_en: After much experimentation, they found the right formula.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 经过大量实验，他们找到了正确的配方。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the quality of having layers of meaning or visual interest, and a sense of motion or flow
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 深度与动态感（艺术效果）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作 achieving 的宾语，表示通过技法的改进实现了更大的深度和动态感。
vocab_pack.example_en: The painting has a remarkable depth and movement.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这幅画具有出色的深度和动态感。
